lines.en: I crawl over sand in a heavy shell.

lines.zh: 源石从我的关节冒出来。
lines.en: Originium pushes out of my joints.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，像在拖着山。
lines.en: Slow, as if dragging a hill.

lines.zh: 我的尾节一节节摆过去。
lines.en: My tail segments swing behind me.
I crawl toward heat.
My shell presses grooves in sand.
I skirt the slag heap.

lines.zh: 我的身体很重，走两步停一下。
lines.en: Heavy. Two steps, then a pause.

lines.zh: 晶体在我背上闪着暗光。
lines.en: Crystals glimmer darkly on my back.
I follow the ore vein for a while.
Ash stays where I pass.
No hurry. Nor the ash.
I crawl from the abandoned shaft.
Every step brings a rasp of grit.
The ground shivers as I near.
Head low, I shuffle forward.
I lie like a lump of ore.
The stone grows slowly in my shell.
I listen to the seam shifting.
Sand works into my joints.

lines.zh: 壳里的晶体又长厚一层。
lines.en: Another layer of crystal grows in my shell.
Sand has filled up my joints.
The crystals glow on their own.
I have been in this waste a long time.
I wait for the ground to shake again.
My shell cracks and regrows.
A small bug crosses my claw.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，很难看见。
lines.en: Still, I am hard to notice.
Another one comes.
This stone weighs more than you.

lines.zh: 你手上的武器，打不穿我。
lines.en: That weapon will not pierce me.
The living always want to prove something.
This waste has no master.
You stand where ore once lay.

lines.zh: 你的轮廓在我眼里发白。
lines.en: Your outline pales in my sight.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，我不喜欢。
lines.en: I dislike the heat on you.
Strike or leave. Do not dawdle.
I have had no opponent in a while.
A crystal breaks off me.
Violet grit scatters on the sand.

lines.zh: 我缓缓地朝你那边挪了半寸。
lines.en: I inch half a pace toward you.
I nearly forgot the word pain.
Another crack in the shell.
I do not cry out. The stone is silent.
You can hit me. You cannot finish.

lines.zh: 伤口处的矿脉断了一截。
lines.en: The seam at my wound snapped short.
My fragments keep growing.
The stone mends me.
That raw ore. Give it here.
Not iron. Stone.

lines.zh: 你把矿举起来，我看见了。
lines.en: I saw you lift the ore.
Ten paces back, then raise it.
Enough to grow an inch.
Food? My stomach is long gone.
That would make me harder.
Do not throw it. It shatters.

lines.zh: 那块矿，你握得比我还紧。
lines.en: You grip that ore tighter than I would.
Leave the ore and go.

lines.zh: 撞上我的壳，你的骨头会响。
lines.en: Hit my shell. Your bones will ring.
I do not move. You back away.
Crystals catch your sleeve.
My weight is greater than it looks.

lines.zh: 三百五十点生命，我烧得起。
lines.en: Three hundred fifty health; I can burn.

lines.zh: 碰撞让一块晶体掉下来。
lines.en: A crystal breaks off in the bump.
I turn slowly to look at you.
You step back; sand takes your feet.

lines.zh: 你撞在我晶体上，弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my crystals and bounced off.
I cannot be bothered to shove.
Originium worms do not discuss that.
Three hundred fifty. I can endure.

lines.zh: 这具身体早没有那种念头。
lines.en: This body has long lost that urge.
I hear the question and forget it.

lines.zh: 矿石会一直长，我不需要后代。
lines.en: The ore grows. I need no heirs.

lines.zh: 别问了，我脑子也结晶了。
lines.en: Stop. My mind crystallized too.
When we meet, we compare hardness.
This seam is home enough.
Worry about surviving.
Move along. That is dull.
I swallow this slag.
Your fallen iron. I leave it.
I lift the ore in my jaws.
The ore dust on the ground is mine.
I press it into a shell seam.
Too big. I break it first.
Afterward, I am a little heavier.
I dig out what the sand hides.
Your weapon fell by the vein.
It belongs to the vein, not me.
Weapon raised. Good.

lines.zh: 我把前半身从沙里抬起来。
lines.en: I lift my front half out of the sand.
No one touches this seam.
The stone tightens inside me.
Your heat is too obvious.

lines.zh: 你踩的这块地，是我的矿。
lines.en: The ground you stand on is my ore.

lines.zh: 这一下，是为了我的地盘。
lines.en: This is for my ground.
You have backed to the old shaft.
Each step of mine shakes the ground.

lines.zh: 我的壳刮着地，起了火星。
lines.en: My shell scrapes the ground and throws sparks.
Your weapon breaks first.

lines.zh: 源石虫的壳，挡得住喊声。
lines.en: This originium shell swallows your shouting.
I press the sand down, inching closer.
Sand sinks under my shell.
Cracks spread under you.
I am slow. So are you.
My crystals are glowing.

lines.zh: 你听得见关节的响声吗？
lines.en: Hear my joints grind?

lines.zh: 你每退一步，晶体就多一根。
lines.en: Each step you give, another crystal rises.
The seam is waking.
Closer and you are in the ash.
I need not chase. The ore traps.
Your armor will not stop stone.
The last step. No hurry.
My jaws clamp your armor.
That blow carries stone grit.
The weight drops you to a knee.
My tail sweeps; you give ground.
Crystals burst at your feet.
Not heavy. Blunt.
I rise again, slowly.

lines.zh: 伤口里开始有紫色的纹。
lines.en: Violet lines spread from the wound.
Your blade slid off my shell.
I do not shout. Stone does not shout.
The old shaft shudders.
Something crawls from the seam.

lines.zh: 沙地上多了紫黑色的光。
lines.en: A violet-black glow on the sand.
I crawl out from under the slag.

lines.zh: 地面裂开一道，我出来了。
lines.en: A crack opens and I come out.

lines.zh: 你听见石头摩擦的声音吗？
lines.en: Hear the stone grinding?
The vein ran wild and I woke.
One more of us on this waste.
My shell moves for the first time.
Ash settles over me.
Fire makes my shell brittle.

lines.zh: 我从矿口滚下，碎了几块。
lines.en: I roll down the shaft and chip.

lines.zh: 三百五十点血，你也得武装起来。
lines.en: Three hundred fifty health — you'd better arm up.
The blast scatters half of me.
An arrow lodges deep in a crystal gap.

lines.zh: 法术让源石暂时静下来。
lines.en: Arts quiet the stone briefly.
No ore, and my shell thins.

lines.zh: 雷电顺着晶体爬满全身。
lines.en: Lightning crawls over every crystal.
The sand floor is gone. Void below.
